overall: The AG found the Everett School Committee violated the Open Meeting Law by responding to seven prior complaints a few days after its final extended deadline, and ordered future compliance.

allegations.summary: Complainant alleged the Committee failed to timely respond to seven earlier Open Meeting Law complaints filed in April and May, with the response coming after the deadline.
allegations.key_passage: Therefore, the Committee violated the Open Meeting Law by failing to respond to the seven prior complaints within 14 business days, or within the time allotted pursuant to an extension granted by this office.

remedy: Immediate and future compliance with the Open Meeting Law.
remedy_passage: We order the Committee’s immediate and future compliance with the Open Meeting Law.
note: Read by a language model from the letter; every key passage is checked verbatim against it and dropped if not. A holding is the Attorney General’s reading of the law in this case only.
